name: roundofschatz
description: Claude plugins by Ryan Schatzman. job-seeker-ops is the full job-search set and includes the other two; resume-ops and plainspeak-writer install on their own.

plugins.name: job-seeker-ops
plugins.description: The full job-search set: works out your case for a posting, writes the cover letter from it, and has a blind reviewer check a finished piece. resume-ops and plainspeak-writer are included, so install this one alone.

plugins.name: resume-ops
plugins.description: Resumes on their own: builds a US resume for one job posting from whatever you have, for the application form, the AI grader, the recruiter and the hiring manager. Already included in job-seeker-ops, so skip this if you install that.

plugins.name: plainspeak-writer
plugins.description: Plain-voice writing on its own: writes and rewrites prose so it reads like a sharp human writer, matched to your own writing when you share some. Already included in job-seeker-ops, so skip this if you install that.
